item.title: Juuma Senki Excellia ~Ishu Kouhai Jikken no Hate ni~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Delta, Trois
  • 発売日: 2011-09-16
  • スコア: 7.0200000000000005/10 (22 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 獣魔戦姫エクセリア ～異種交配実験のはてに～
  • 英語名: Juuma Senki Excellia Ishu Kouhai Jikken no Hate ni

あらすじ

The year is 1761 on the imperial calendar–

the war with the Republic that had continued for a long time until then had brought enormous damage to the empire, which was the country concerned.

Meanwhile, only the army led by Tristan, the empire’s third prince’s younger brother, breaks through the Republic with unstoppable force.

item.title: Monster Park ~Bakemono ni Miirareshi Hime~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Delta, Trois
  • 発売日: 2009-12-18
  • スコア: 6.82/10 (86 人評価)
  • 日本語名: MONSTER PARK～化け物に魅入られし姫～
  • 英語名: Monster Park Bakemono ni Miirareshi Hime

あらすじ

In the land of Gatoria Kingdom, Marion, a prince, is interested in rare kinds of creatures called monsters. One day, he meets Stia, a princess in a neighboring country, in his country and he wants to see Stia having sex with ugly and violent monsters. On the day Stia comes back to her country, Marion intentionally leads her to the forest where monsters live. At the same time, Iris, Marion’s younger sister, accidentally gets lost in the forest….
